subject: EOQ bump: quick check on pilot approval for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo + next steps

Hi Samir — great to meet today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

SUMMARY FROM CALL
- Goal: run a 4-week pilot to validate latency and cost improvements for Acme Cloud’s customer-facing search features.
- Success metrics: tail latency under 200ms p95, 30% reduction in per-query token costs vs current infra, and monitoring for hallucination rate on 3 canonical prompts.
- Scope: 2 endpoints (search-relevance, query-expansion), ~2M monthly queries projected for pilot.

PROPOSED NEXT STEPS
1) Mutual Action Plan: we’ll circulate a short MAP (attached) with milestones and responsibilities.
2) SOW + contract: draft SOW attached for legal review — happy to fast-track redlines.
3) Technical kickoff: provision sandbox access next week; Lauren will lead the integration plan.

TIMING & APPROVAL
- You mentioned a budget review at end-of-quarter. Are you still targeting Q3 budget approval, or has priority shifted given recent exec asks? Knowing this helps us prioritize engineering touchpoints and any pilot scheduling constraints.

ATTACHMENTS
- Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (1 page) — draft milestones and owners
- Pilot_SOW_v1.docx — scope and pricing for 4-week pilot

If that aligns, I can loop in legal/CS and schedule the technical kickoff for next week. If timing slipped, tell me what’s changed and I'll adjust the rollout plan.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
